threepl.procs

Class InbuiltProcs

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.procs.InbuiltProcs

  • public class InbuiltProcs
extends java.lang.Object
    This class is only instantiated once as a static class in main. It is a map of all inbuilt procedures.

    • Constructor Detail

      • InbuiltProcs

        public InbuiltProcs()
        Construct the map of all inbuilt procedures. Each inbuilt procedure has an identifier and a class with an execute method which implements the procedure. This class contains a map whose indices are the procedure identifiers and whose values are the procedure classes. The explicit procedure identifiers and associated classes are coded into the body of this constructor.

      • findProcId

        public static java.lang.String findProcId(InbuiltProc p)
        Search the inbuilt procedure map for the identifier of a procedure. This is only used to recover the procedure identifier when invoking execution via a pointer.
        Parameters:
        p - is the procedure
        Returns:
        the procedure identifier
